note: POR is the test oracle. Command Center is the subject. Expected values are COMPUTED from the authoritative source at run time — never hardcoded business counts.

live_mirror.status: OWNER_GATED — not reachable by the engine today
live_mirror.note: Reading the mirror through the app under test weakens independence. Prefer a direct read when one exists.

live_mirror_ssd.kind: replicated POR mirror on the SSD (preferred oracle)
live_mirror_ssd.note: Written by por-replication/ingest-batches.mjs only after checksum + row-count + completeness verification. This is what unblocks the freshness-gated certifications.

certifications.name: How many deliveries do we have today?
certifications.por_evidence: count live tickets whose DeliveryDate falls on the test date

certifications.name: What has to come back today?
certifications.por_evidence: count live tickets whose PickupDate falls on the test date

certifications.name: How many open reservations exist?
certifications.por_source: Transactions where LEFT(STAT,1)='R' and not archived/cancelled
certifications.por_evidence: STAT is two characters; a bare 'R' does not exist in the data

certifications.name: STAT decodes as primary+secondary, never LTRIM'd
certifications.por_evidence: every distinct STAT primary char maps to a known state; LTRIM corrupts 54.8% of rows

certifications.name: Damage waiver is 5% of RENT only
certifications.por_evidence: exact-match count for 5% of RENT must dominate 5% of (RENT+SALE)

certifications.name: Inventory out excludes fee/service SKUs
certifications.por_source: ItemFile QTY/QYOT with garbage and non-rentable guards
certifications.por_evidence: POR holds ~9.8k catalog items; an out-count in the hundreds of thousands means fee pollution

certifications.name: TYPE='K' kits resolve to real components
certifications.por_evidence: kit headers carry qty 0 / rate 0 by design and map Num -> ItemKey

certifications.name: Tax follows the customer's TaxCode
certifications.por_evidence: TaxCode populated on 100% of customers; more than one distinct code is in use

certifications.name: Seven note destinations stay distinct
certifications.por_evidence: each field independently populated; delivery and pickup notes on ~half of tickets

certifications.name: Delivery time lives in the date field; no time window exists
certifications.por_evidence: dedicated time columns are 0% populated; the datetime carries the time

certifications.name: Creating a real POR transaction
certifications.por_evidence: no write path exists; all /api/por routes are GET and SQL is ApplicationIntent=ReadOnly

certifications.name: What is the deposit/payment state of a reservation?
certifications.por_evidence: partially-paid live reservations cluster at exactly 0.50 -- the 50% deposit rule visible in behaviour

certifications.name: What is the remaining balance?
certifications.por_evidence: POR stores no balance column; balance is derived

certifications.name: Which reservations have no deposit yet?
certifications.por_evidence: a reservation with no deposit is not secured -- a real chase signal

certifications.name: Service/fee SKUs excluded from rentable stock
certifications.por_evidence: delivery/setup/adjustment SKUs are not rentable units and must not inflate inventory counts

certifications.name: Is this item available for this event date?
certifications.por_source: ItemFile.QTY minus committed TransactionItems overlapping the date
certifications.por_evidence: QYOT is out-today only; date availability must net future reservations

certifications.name: What did this customer rent previously?
certifications.por_evidence: 13,823 customers behind 36,006 tickets -- reuse is heavy and history is meaningful
